searchResults.jobSummary: Join Apple's Silicon Engineering Group (SEG) and be at the forefront of shaping the next generation of Apple's systems-on-chip (SOCs)! Our SOCs, featuring multi-billion transistors, are the heart of iconic devices like iPhones, iPads, and Macs. We're seeking a highly skilled Analog Layout Automation Engineer to contribute to the evolution of Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS) circuits, covering SerDes, PLLs, and sensors, with a focus on automation and leveraging AI/ML techniques for improved design and efficiency.

As member of the DV CAD team, you have the opportunity to impact Apple engineers who develop next generation of Apple products!
You will be responsible for developing software solutions used by thousands of DV engineers globally. You will be supporting design process of all chip families Apple makes (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and more), and your work will help streamline this complex process. This role combines DV knowledge alongside modern software engineering practices. Your work will be very diverse, and you will have broad impact contributing to the success of Apple silicon.
